rules.check: reject behavioral storage declarations matching reg [..] mem [0:..]; require a hard macro such as fakeram45_* for true SRAM
rules.rationale: behavioral arrays synthesize to flops/muxes, not a real SRAM macro

rules.check: prove accumulator width against K and signed INT4 product range; flag if insufficient
rules.rationale: 12-bit signed max 2047 cannot represent K=32 times product 64 = 2048

rules.check: trace mac enable against registered SRAM address/data and reject control that can reuse a response across multiple accumulation cycles
rules.rationale: registered SRAM protocols can silently count elements twice
